notes.title: Rock Simulator 2 Release Date + Price Adjustment
notes.notes:
[h1][b]ROCK SIMULATOR 2 RELEASE DATE[/b][/h1]

Nearly four years ago I created a silly little game with no reason or purpose. It was meant as a joke with an unlikely future. Thanks to each and every one of you I am here making a sequel that is bigger and better than the original. I have listened and learned along the way, adding many of the requested features and plenty more to come post-launch. 

I have a dream of developing games for the rest of my life, maybe more rock games lul, or a more serious title. Whatever it may be in the future I am thankful for YOU. 

[b]I am proud to announce the planned release date for Rock Simulator 2[/b]
[h3][b]NOVEMBER 30TH [/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949770/Rock_Simulator_2/

Adding the title to your wishlist is greatly appreciated. Tell all of your friends too! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Rock Simulator Price Adjustment[/h1]
To continue selling the game in certain regions I will be required to make a slight price adjustment in certain regions. The USD price of the title will remain $1.99 and $3.99 (Rock Pass.) Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC + Preliminary Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Upcoming Patch Notes for November 27th[/h1]

[b]Rock Pass![/b][list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436660/Rock_Simulator__Rock_Pass/]Rock Pass is now available for Wishlists![/url]
[*] The Rock Pass is the first DLC being added to Rock Simulator on November 27th! It currently includes 30 unlockable levels each with its own reward. You progress by simply leveling up (30 levels = 1 Rock Pass level.) It currently requires 900 levels to complete the Rock Pass which will take around 20 hours to complete in total. [b]You will still earn progress towards the Rock Pass even if you have not purchased it yet, but the items will not be usable until then.[/b]
[*] The Rock Pass currently includes 2 maps (each with a new puzzle to complete and skins to unlock through completing the puzzles) and 28 new skins (15 static and 13 animated.) I will break this down further on the release day.
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer Improvements![/b][list]
[*] You can now click on a rock in a multiplayer session to view the user's profile. (This has been one of the most requested features!) 
[*] Hovering over a rock in a multiplayer session will now display the user's name and level
[*] The user's name will appear in gold if they have ascended and in red if they are over level 5000
[*] Updated the looks of the lobby selector
[*] The name of a multiplayer session will now appear in gold if the host of the lobby has ascended, and red if they are over level 5000
[*] You can now host private matches if you only want to rock with your friends
[/list]

The patch notes will be broken down further on release day.
Let me know your opinion on this update below! 
If you find any bugs feel free to message me on discord @Park#6615 or on Steam
